candidates.change_summary: Change paused() to always return true instead of reading _paused.
Change paused() to always return false instead of reading _paused.
Negate the stored _paused value so paused() returns !_paused.
Replace the non-zero address check with no check, allowing zero address to be set as lrtConfig.
Emit UpdatedLRTConfig before updating the lrtConfig state variable (swap order), so emitted address differs from stored value at event time.

Change admin check to require that msg.sender DOES have DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE instead of reverting when it does not (use require with opposite message) — here we invert the condition to always revert for admins, preventing admins from calling updateLRTConfig.
Change initial maxNodeDelegatorCount from 10 to 20 in C.initialize, so after initialize the stored value differs.
Set maxNodeDelegatorCount to 0 instead of 10 in C.initialize, changing post-initialization value.
Remove the assignment to maxNodeDelegatorCount so it remains at default (0) rather than being set to 10.

Modify initializer modifier to set _initialized = 2 instead of 1, causing initialize to leave maxNodeDelegatorCount potentially different due to initializer logic path (affects initialization behavior observable after initialize).
